archetypeNotes: Storm / ritual combo. Lowest curve (avg MV 2.34) and fewest lands (31) in the corpus; 5 tutors, 9 fast mana, 3 free spells. Underworld Breach / Grapeshot / Walking Ballista lines. Contains Tainted Pact without Thassa's Oracle (partial combo only).
curatorRationale: High-power non-cEDH, unambiguous. Only storm deck and only commander-independent shell among the player decks. The corpus's only source of free interaction.
